stories.title: Federal Reserve: US-Notenbank erhöht erstmals seit 2023 den Leitzins

en.title: Federal Reserve: US central bank raises key interest rate for first time since 2023
en.summary: The Federal Reserve increased its benchmark interest rate by 0.25 percentage points in response to rising inflation. US President Donald Trump criticized the decision.

stories.title: Europa League: Bayer Leverkusen siegt im Auftaktspiel gegen NK Celje

en.title: Europa League: Bayer Leverkusen wins opening match against NK Celje
en.summary: Bayer Leverkusen secured an unimpressive victory against NK Celje in the Europa League's first matchday. An own goal by the Slovenian team gave Leverkusen the lead.

stories.title: Geldpolitik: US-Notenbank erhöht Zinsen erstmals seit drei Jahren

en.title: Monetary policy: US central bank raises interest rates for first time in three years
en.summary: New Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh raised the benchmark interest rate due to persistent high inflation. US President Donald Trump quickly criticized the move, arguing that low interest rates are patriotic.

stories.title: Bayer Leverkusen startet mit Heimsieg in die Europa League

en.title: Bayer Leverkusen starts Europa League with home victory
en.summary: Bayer Leverkusen opened its Europa League campaign with a 2-0 win against NK Celje at home, though the German team missed numerous scoring opportunities.

stories.title: Pflichtaufgabe erfüllt: Leverkusen gewinnt Auftaktspiel in der Europa League

en.title: Duty fulfilled: Leverkusen wins opening match in Europa League
en.summary: Bayer Leverkusen defeated Slovenian club NK Celje in their Europa League opener through a dominant performance, though finishing and opposing goalkeeper created challenges.

en.title: US Federal Reserve raises key interest rate for first time since 2023
en.summary: The US Federal Reserve increased its benchmark interest rate by one quarter point to a range of 3.75 to 4.00 percent as part of efforts to combat persistent inflation.

stories.title: Fußball: Bayer Leverkusen startet mit Heimsieg in die Europa League

en.title: Football: Bayer Leverkusen starts Europa League with home victory
en.summary: Bayer Leverkusen won their opening Europa League match at home.

stories.title: US-Wirtschaft: US-Notenbank erhöht erstmals seit Juli 2023 wieder Leitzins

en.title: US Economy: US Federal Reserve raises interest rate for first time since July 2023
en.summary: The US Federal Reserve raised its interest rate for the first time since July 2023.

stories.title: US-Notenbank Fed erhöht Leitzins erstmals seit 2023

en.title: US Federal Reserve raises key interest rate for first time since 2023
en.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh increased the benchmark interest rate for the first time in over three years, citing the Iran conflict and elevated inflation, positioning himself at odds with President Trump.

stories.title: Friedrich Merz: Auch Wirtschaftsflügel der Union stellt sich hinter den Kanzler

en.title: Friedrich Merz: CDU's business wing also supports the chancellor
en.summary: Friedrich Merz received backing from the CDU parliamentary group's business wing after receiving support from CDU state premiers. A business association leader praised him as the right person in the right position.

stories.title: CDU: Friedrich Merz - was hinter der Solidaritätsadresse der Ministerpräsidenten steckt

en.title: CDU: Friedrich Merz - what lies behind the minister-presidents' solidarity address
en.summary: Eight CDU-led state premiers oppose discussions about minority governments and personnel changes, providing Chancellor Merz with political support, at least for now.

stories.title: CDU-Ministerpräsidenten stellen sich hinter Kanzler Merz - dazu Matthias Deiß, ARD Berlin

en.title: CDU minister-presidents stand behind Chancellor Merz - with Matthias Deiß, ARD Berlin
en.summary: CDU-led state premiers express support for Chancellor Merz.

stories.title: Künstliche Intelligenz: Banken stellen 22 Milliarden für KI-Projekt von Google und Blackstone

en.title: Artificial intelligence: Banks provide 22 billion for Google and Blackstone AI project
en.summary: Ten banks granted a multi-billion dollar loan to Crux AI, the joint cloud venture of Blackstone and Google. The financing supports continued expansion of artificial intelligence infrastructure.

stories.title: US-Notenbank: 25 Basispunkte für die Glaubwürdigkeit von Kevin Warsh

en.title: US Federal Reserve: 25 basis points for Kevin Warsh's credibility
en.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh raised interest rates to demonstrate his independence from the US government, addressing concerns about his autonomy from the White House.

stories.title: Fed: Zinswende vor den Midterms: Fed hebt Leitzinsen erstmals seit 2023 an

en.title: Fed: Interest rate shift before midterms: Fed raises key rates for first time since 2023
en.summary: The Federal Reserve increased its key interest rates for the first time since 2023, citing a strong labor market and persistent inflation as justification for the decision.

stories.title: Hohe Spritpreise: Italien und Frankreich reagieren auf steigende Kraftstoffpreise

en.title: High fuel prices: Italy and France respond to rising fuel costs
en.summary: Italy plans to suspend vehicle taxes for certain cars from 2027 to help millions of drivers with high fuel expenses, while France extends fuel subsidies for specific sectors.

stories.title: ARD und ZDF: SPD wirft Weimer indirekte Wahlkampfhilfe für AfD vor

en.title: ARD and ZDF: SPD accuses Weimer of indirect campaign support for AfD
en.summary: A state culture minister proposed privatizing ZDF and dissolving smaller ARD public broadcasters. The AfD endorsed the proposal while the SPD expressed strong disapproval.
